DEV-01.reference_answer: Requests for 5 or more consecutive working days must be submitted at least 21 calendar days in advance.

DEV-02.reference_answer: KeyVault is the only approved password manager; it is installed on all company laptops.

DEV-03.reference_answer: The IT Service Desk can be reached on internal extension 4357.

DEV-04.reference_answer: Public Wi-Fi may be used for work only when connected through the company VPN, and employees must connect to company systems through the VPN at all times when working from home.

DEV-05.reference_answer: Yes, premium economy may be booked for journeys of 6 hours or longer, and meals are reimbursed up to USD 60 per day.
